nvitk.gui.viz.flow_streamlines
==============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.flow_streamlines

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Napari 4D flow streamlines / pathlines overlay (phase-synced Vectors lines).

.. py:function:: build_flow_streamline_cache(ap: numpy.ndarray, rl: numpy.ndarray, fh: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray, *, phase_layer: Any = None, label_ids: list[int] | None = None, trace_mode: str = 'streamlines', n_seeds: int = 64, max_length: float = 35.0, stream_seed: int | None = 42, integration_direction: str = 'forward', seed_mode: str = 'planar', seed_plane_axis: int = 2, seed_plane_side: str = 'min', dt_seconds: float = 1.0, resample_paths: bool = False, resample_spacing_vox: float = 0.5, edge_width: float = 0.25, opacity: float = 0.55, colormap: str = 'turbo', color_metric: str = 'speed', per_vertex_color: bool = True) -> FlowStreamlineCache

   Build velocity volume and trace parameters.


.. py:function:: precompute_flow_streamline_frames(cache: FlowStreamlineCache) -> None

   Integrate traces for every cardiac phase (makes scrubbing instant).


.. py:function:: flow_streamline_frame(cache: FlowStreamlineCache, time_index: int) -> tuple[list[numpy.ndarray], list]

   Return display paths and RGBA edge colors for one cardiac phase.

   .. py:attribute:: layer

   .. py:attribute:: dims_callback
      :type:  Callable[[Any], None]


.. py:function:: stop_flow_streamline_playback(viewer: Any) -> None

   Disconnect dims hooks from a prior flow-trace overlay.


.. py:function:: add_animated_flow_streamlines_layer(viewer: Any, cache: FlowStreamlineCache, *, phase_layer: Any, spatial_reference_layer: Any = None, name: str = FLOW_STREAMLINES_LAYER, initial_time: int = 0, sync_dims: bool = True) -> FlowStreamlinePlayback

   Add flow traces; sync paths to the Napari dims slider / play bar.
